summary: Tirzepatide is a peptide in the incretin & amylin analogs class (GIP and GLP-1 receptor dual agonist). Europe PMC indexes 2,756 publications naming it or a listed alias in a title or abstract, including 131 randomized controlled trials and 109 clinical trials of any design, as of 2026-09-14. The strongest evidence tier in that literature is an approved medicine with a regulator-reviewed label. This page reports what those studies state, sentence by sentence, with each statement tied to its source and labeled by the kind of evidence it is. It does not recommend use, and it does not translate study doses into anything personal.

seo.title: Tirzepatide: what the research shows
seo.description: Tirzepatide research, cited: 2,756 indexed publications, 131 randomized trials. Evidence tier on every claim; nothing is advice.

routes_studied.value: Randomized controlled trial, humans, n=6,586, 2026: administration by subcutaneous route reported. Participants were randomized to receive subcutaneous tirzepatide up to 15 mg (n = 6586) or a fixed dose of dulaglutide, 1.5 mg (n = 6579), administered weekly.
routes_studied.source_excerpt: Participants were randomized to receive subcutaneous tirzepatide up to 15 mg (n = 6586) or a fixed dose of dulaglutide, 1.5 mg (n = 6579), administered weekly.
routes_studied.plain: In the SURPASS-CVOT trial analyzed in 2026, people with diabetes and heart disease received weekly injections under the skin of tirzepatide up to 15 mg (6586 people) or dulaglutide 1.5 mg (6579 people).

routes_studied.value: Randomized controlled trial, humans, n=441, 2026: administration by subcutaneous route reported. After completing the initial weight-loss period with once weekly subcutaneous tirzepatide at the MTD (10 mg or 15 mg), adults (aged ≥18 years) with a BMI of 30 kg/m 2 and above or 27 kg/m 2 and above with one or more weight-related comorbidity, and a history of at least one self-reported unsuccessful dietary effort to lose bodyweight were randomly assigned in a 3:3:2 ratio to continue tirzepatide MTD, reduce to tirzepatide 5 mg, or switch to placebo for an additional 52 weeks.
routes_studied.source_excerpt: After completing the initial weight-loss period with once weekly subcutaneous tirzepatide at the MTD (10 mg or 15 mg), adults (aged ≥18 years) with a BMI of 30 kg/m 2 and above or 27 kg/m 2 and above with one or more weight-related comorbidity, and a history of at least one self-reported unsuccessful dietary effort to lose bodyweight were randomly assigned in a 3:3:2 ratio to continue tirzepatide MTD, reduce to tirzepatide 5 mg, or switch to placebo for an additional 52 weeks.
routes_studied.plain: In the 2026 SURMOUNT-MAINTAIN trial, adults with obesity first lost weight on once-weekly tirzepatide injections under the skin at 10 mg or 15 mg, then continued that dose, dropped to 5 mg, or switched to placebo for 52 weeks.

study_doses.value: Randomized controlled trial, humans, 2026: doses stated in the abstract: 10 mg. These post hoc analyses examined data from two Phase 3 randomized, double-blind studies evaluating maximum tolerated dose (MTD) tirzepatide (10 mg or 15 mg) compared with placebo in adults with moderate-to-severe OSA (AHI ≥ 15 events/h) and obesity (BMI ≥ 30 kg/m 2 ) over a 52-week period.
study_doses.source_excerpt: These post hoc analyses examined data from two Phase 3 randomized, double-blind studies evaluating maximum tolerated dose (MTD) tirzepatide (10 mg or 15 mg) compared with placebo in adults with moderate-to-severe OSA (AHI ≥ 15 events/h) and obesity (BMI ≥ 30 kg/m 2 ) over a 52-week period.
study_doses.plain: This 2026 after-the-fact analysis of two phase 3 SURMOUNT-OSA trials compared tirzepatide at the highest tolerated dose (10 mg or 15 mg) with placebo over 52 weeks in adults with obesity and moderate-to-severe obstructive sleep apnea.

study_doses.value: Randomized controlled trial, humans, n=6,586, 2026: doses stated in the abstract: 15 mg. Participants were randomized to receive subcutaneous tirzepatide up to 15 mg (n = 6586) or a fixed dose of dulaglutide, 1.5 mg (n = 6579), administered weekly.
study_doses.source_excerpt: Participants were randomized to receive subcutaneous tirzepatide up to 15 mg (n = 6586) or a fixed dose of dulaglutide, 1.5 mg (n = 6579), administered weekly.
study_doses.plain: In the SURPASS-CVOT trial analyzed in 2026, people with diabetes and heart disease received weekly tirzepatide up to 15 mg (6586 people) or a fixed dulaglutide dose of 1.5 mg (6579 people).

study_doses.source_excerpt: Of 750 participants, 383 met the criteria for obesity disease (tirzepatide 15 mg or maximum tolerated dose [MTD], n = 190; semaglutide 2.4 mg or MTD, n = 193).
study_doses.plain: In a 2026 analysis of a global trial, 383 of 750 participants met Japan's criteria for obesity disease: 190 received tirzepatide 15 mg (or highest tolerated dose) and 193 received semaglutide 2.4 mg (or highest tolerated dose).

study_doses.value: Randomized controlled trial, humans, n=441, 2026: doses stated in the abstract: 10 mg; 5 mg. After completing the initial weight-loss period with once weekly subcutaneous tirzepatide at the MTD (10 mg or 15 mg), adults (aged ≥18 years) with a BMI of 30 kg/m 2 and above or 27 kg/m 2 and above with one or more weight-related comorbidity, and a history of at least one self-reported unsuccessful dietary effort to lose bodyweight were randomly assigned in a 3:3:2 ratio to continue tirzepatide MTD, reduce to tirzepatide 5 mg, or switch to placebo for an additional 52 weeks.

study_doses.value: Randomized controlled trial, humans, 2026: doses stated in the abstract: 5 mg once weekly. Sixty overweight/obese women with PCOS were randomised to the MET group (1000 mg twice daily [BID]) or the COM group (MET: 1000 mg BID, tirzepatide: 5 mg once weekly [QW]) for 16 weeks.
study_doses.source_excerpt: Sixty overweight/obese women with PCOS were randomised to the MET group (1000 mg twice daily [BID]) or the COM group (MET: 1000 mg BID, tirzepatide: 5 mg once weekly [QW]) for 16 weeks.
study_doses.plain: In a 2026 open-label trial (no blinding) of sixty Chinese women with overweight or obesity and PCOS, one group took metformin 1000 mg twice daily and the other took the same metformin plus tirzepatide 5 mg once weekly for 16 weeks.

study_doses.value: Randomized controlled trial, humans, n=63, 2026: doses stated in the abstract: 10 mg; 15 mg. Prespecified analyses assessed changes from baseline to Week 72 in HR-QoL using the Impact of Weight on Quality of Life-Lite-Clinical Trials Version (IWQOL-Lite-CT) and 36-Item Short-Form Health Survey Version 2.0 (SF-36v2), and assessed subgroup differences by sex (male, female), baseline body mass index ( 2 ) and age ( Results Among 201 participants (tirzepatide 10 mg: n = 63; tirzepatide 15 mg: n = 69; placebo: n = 69), both tirzepatide doses significantly improved IWQOL-Lite-CT Physical Function composite, Physical composite, Psychosocial composite and Total scores and the SF-36v2 Physical Functioning domain score at Week 72 versus placebo.
study_doses.source_excerpt: Prespecified analyses assessed changes from baseline to Week 72 in HR-QoL using the Impact of Weight on Quality of Life-Lite-Clinical Trials Version (IWQOL-Lite-CT) and 36-Item Short-Form Health Survey Version 2.0 (SF-36v2), and assessed subgroup differences by sex (male, female), baseline body mass index ( 2 ) and age ( Results Among 201 participants (tirzepatide 10 mg: n = 63; tirzepatide 15 mg: n = 69; placebo: n = 69), both tirzepatide doses significantly improved IWQOL-Lite-CT Physical Function composite, Physical composite, Psychosocial composite and Total scores and the SF-36v2 Physical Functioning domain score at Week 72 versus placebo.
study_doses.plain: In the 2026 SURMOUNT-J analysis of 201 Japanese adults with obesity disease, 63 received tirzepatide 10 mg, 69 received tirzepatide 15 mg and 69 received placebo, with quality of life measured to week 72.

escalation_schedules.value: Randomized controlled trial, humans, 2026: Participants were randomly assigned 1:1 to continue with and escalate to dulaglutide 4.5 mg or maximum tolerated dose (MTD) or switch to tirzepatide with escalation to 15 mg or MTD.
escalation_schedules.source_excerpt: Participants were randomly assigned 1:1 to continue with and escalate to dulaglutide 4.5 mg or maximum tolerated dose (MTD) or switch to tirzepatide with escalation to 15 mg or MTD.
escalation_schedules.plain: In the 2026 SURPASS-SWITCH subgroup analysis in type 2 diabetes, participants either continued dulaglutide, raised to 4.5 mg or highest tolerated dose, or switched to tirzepatide raised to 15 mg or highest tolerated dose.

interactions.value: Randomized controlled trial, humans, 2026: Overall, 27.1% of participants simultaneously achieved PASI 100 and a 10% or greater weight reduction with ixekizumab plus tirzepatide vs 5.8% with ixekizumab (risk difference [RD], 21.2%; 95% CI, 12.8%-29.7%; P Conclusions and relevance The trial results suggest that concomitant ixekizumab and tirzepatide produced clinically meaningful, statistically significant improvements in skin clearance and reductions in weight in participants with moderate to severe psoriasis, with no new safety concerns, while providing additional cardiometabolic benefits and a potential to elevate care.
interactions.source_excerpt: Overall, 27.1% of participants simultaneously achieved PASI 100 and a 10% or greater weight reduction with ixekizumab plus tirzepatide vs 5.8% with ixekizumab (risk difference [RD], 21.2%; 95% CI, 12.8%-29.7%; P Conclusions and relevance The trial results suggest that concomitant ixekizumab and tirzepatide produced clinically meaningful, statistically significant improvements in skin clearance and reductions in weight in participants with moderate to severe psoriasis, with no new safety concerns, while providing additional cardiometabolic benefits and a potential to elevate care.
interactions.plain: In a 2026 phase 3b trial in adults with psoriasis and overweight or obesity, 27.1% on ixekizumab plus tirzepatide reached fully clear skin (PASI 100) and 10% or more weight loss, against 5.8% on ixekizumab alone.

interactions.value: Randomized controlled trial, humans, n=102, 2026: In summary, this proof-of-concept study demonstrated that selective targeting of myostatin by apitegromab was well tolerated and effective in preserving lean mass when combined with tirzepatide.
interactions.source_excerpt: In summary, this proof-of-concept study demonstrated that selective targeting of myostatin by apitegromab was well tolerated and effective in preserving lean mass when combined with tirzepatide.
interactions.plain: In a 2026 phase 2 placebo-controlled trial of 102 people, the authors reported that apitegromab (a drug that blocks myostatin, a muscle-growth brake) was well tolerated and helped preserve lean mass when combined with tirzepatide.

interactions.value: Randomized controlled trial, humans, 2026: This study aimed to assess the effects of low-dose tirzepatide combined with metformin (COM) versus metformin (MET) monotherapy in overweight/obese women with polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS).
interactions.source_excerpt: This study aimed to assess the effects of low-dose tirzepatide combined with metformin (COM) versus metformin (MET) monotherapy in overweight/obese women with polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS).
interactions.plain: This 2026 trial in women with overweight or obesity and PCOS (polycystic ovary syndrome) compared low-dose tirzepatide plus metformin with metformin alone.

interactions.value: Human study, humans, n=45, 2025: This trial aims to explore the synergistic effects and safety of tirzepatide combined with standard fertility-preserving treatment for endometrial lesions.
interactions.source_excerpt: This trial aims to explore the synergistic effects and safety of tirzepatide combined with standard fertility-preserving treatment for endometrial lesions.
interactions.plain: This 2025 paper describes a phase II single-group trial (no control group) of 45 people with obesity or overweight and early endometrial cancer or precancer, testing tirzepatide added to standard fertility-sparing treatment. No results yet.

exclusion_criteria.value: Approved label (EU, Mounjaro), section 4.3: contraindicated in hypersensitivity to tirzepatide or any excipient.
exclusion_criteria.source_excerpt: Hypersensitivity to the active substance or to any of the excipients listed in section 6.1.
exclusion_criteria.plain: The EU label for Mounjaro lists one outright contraindication: allergy to tirzepatide or to any other ingredient of the injection.

exclusion_criteria.value: Approved label (EU, Mounjaro), section 4.6: not recommended in pregnancy or without contraception; discontinue at least 1 month before a planned pregnancy.
exclusion_criteria.source_excerpt: Tirzepatide is not recommended during pregnancy and in women of childbearing potential not using contraception. If a patient wishes to become pregnant, or pregnancy occurs, tirzepatide should be discontinued. Tirzepatide should be discontinued at least 1 month before a planned pregnancy due to the long half-life (see section 5.2).
exclusion_criteria.plain: The label does not recommend tirzepatide in pregnancy or for women who could become pregnant and are not using contraception. It is stopped at least 1 month before a planned pregnancy because of its long half-life.

exclusion_criteria.value: Approved label (EU, Mounjaro), section 4.4: not studied in a history of pancreatitis; use with caution.
exclusion_criteria.source_excerpt: Tirzepatide has not been studied in patients with a history of pancreatitis, and should be used with caution in these patients.
exclusion_criteria.plain: People with a past episode of pancreatitis were not studied, so the label asks for caution in them. If pancreatitis is confirmed during treatment, tirzepatide is not restarted.

adverse_events.value: Randomized controlled trial, humans, n=6,586, 2026: After a median (IQR) treatment duration of 46.9 (34.6-50.6) months, the primary cardiorenal end point occurred in 1559 tirzepatide-treated patients (23.7%) and 1803 dulaglutide-treated patients (27.4%; hazard ratio [HR], 0.84; 95% CI, 0.79-0.90; P Conclusions In this post hoc analysis, the dual GLP-1 and GIP agonist tirzepatide, compared with the GLP-1 agonist dulaglutide, was associated with a lower incidence of a broad 6-component composite cardiovascular and kidney end point in patients with diabetes and established cardiovascular disease.
adverse_events.source_excerpt: After a median (IQR) treatment duration of 46.9 (34.6-50.6) months, the primary cardiorenal end point occurred in 1559 tirzepatide-treated patients (23.7%) and 1803 dulaglutide-treated patients (27.4%; hazard ratio [HR], 0.84; 95% CI, 0.79-0.90; P Conclusions In this post hoc analysis, the dual GLP-1 and GIP agonist tirzepatide, compared with the GLP-1 agonist dulaglutide, was associated with a lower incidence of a broad 6-component composite cardiovascular and kidney end point in patients with diabetes and established cardiovascular disease.
adverse_events.plain: In a 2026 after-the-fact analysis of SURPASS-CVOT, after a median 46.9 months, a combined heart and kidney outcome occurred in 1559 people (23.7%) on tirzepatide and 1803 (27.4%) on dulaglutide.

adverse_events.value: Randomized controlled trial, humans, n=1,775, 2026: We aimed to assess weight reduction, CRPs, tolerability and hypoglycaemia according to early body weight response to tirzepatide in these studies.
adverse_events.source_excerpt: We aimed to assess weight reduction, CRPs, tolerability and hypoglycaemia according to early body weight response to tirzepatide in these studies.
adverse_events.plain: This 2026 after-the-fact analysis of SURMOUNT-1 and SURMOUNT-2 (1775 people) looked at weight loss, heart and metabolic risk factors, tolerability and low blood sugar by how quickly people first lost weight on tirzepatide.

adverse_events.value: Randomized controlled trial, humans, n=441, 2026: The primary estimand was the modified treatment-regimen estimand, which assumed that participants who initiated rescue tirzepatide would not have gained further benefit from their assigned study treatment and included all randomly allocated participants, regardless of treatment discontinuation or initiation of prohibited medications.
adverse_events.source_excerpt: The primary estimand was the modified treatment-regimen estimand, which assumed that participants who initiated rescue tirzepatide would not have gained further benefit from their assigned study treatment and included all randomly allocated participants, regardless of treatment discontinuation or initiation of prohibited medications.
adverse_events.plain: The 2026 SURMOUNT-MAINTAIN paper describes its main statistical approach, which counted all randomized participants whether or not they stopped treatment or started rescue tirzepatide; this sentence reports no side effect data.

adverse_events.value: Randomized controlled trial, humans, n=102, 2026: In summary, this proof-of-concept study demonstrated that selective targeting of myostatin by apitegromab was well tolerated and effective in preserving lean mass when combined with tirzepatide.
adverse_events.source_excerpt: In summary, this proof-of-concept study demonstrated that selective targeting of myostatin by apitegromab was well tolerated and effective in preserving lean mass when combined with tirzepatide.
adverse_events.plain: In a 2026 phase 2 placebo-controlled trial of 102 people, apitegromab (a myostatin-blocking drug) given with tirzepatide was reported as well tolerated while preserving lean mass.

adverse_events.value: Randomized controlled trial, humans, 2026: In this subgroup analysis of SURPASS-SWITCH, switching to tirzepatide from dulaglutide was generally well-tolerated and associated with significant and consistent improvements in HbA1c and weight reductions versus dulaglutide across all baseline subgroups evaluated.
adverse_events.source_excerpt: In this subgroup analysis of SURPASS-SWITCH, switching to tirzepatide from dulaglutide was generally well-tolerated and associated with significant and consistent improvements in HbA1c and weight reductions versus dulaglutide across all baseline subgroups evaluated.
adverse_events.plain: In a 2026 SURPASS-SWITCH subgroup analysis in type 2 diabetes, switching from dulaglutide to tirzepatide was reported as generally well tolerated, with larger HbA1c (three-month blood sugar average) and weight drops than dulaglutide in all subgroups.

adverse_events.value: Randomized controlled trial, humans, n=42, 2025: To evaluate counterregulatory hormonal responses during a hypoglycemic clamp with tirzepatide.
adverse_events.source_excerpt: To evaluate counterregulatory hormonal responses during a hypoglycemic clamp with tirzepatide.
adverse_events.plain: This 2025 placebo-controlled study of 42 people with type 2 diabetes measured the body's hormone defense against low blood sugar during a controlled low-blood-sugar test while on tirzepatide.

biomarkers_monitored.value: Randomized controlled trial, humans, 2026: Given that excess adiposity is a known risk factor for OSA, we aimed to descriptively assess the association of tirzepatide, a GIP/GLP-1 receptor agonist, with changes in AHI, hypoxic burden, body weight, and blood pressure in different patient populations based on baseline characteristics such as age, sex, BMI, AHI, and neck circumference.
biomarkers_monitored.source_excerpt: Given that excess adiposity is a known risk factor for OSA, we aimed to descriptively assess the association of tirzepatide, a GIP/GLP-1 receptor agonist, with changes in AHI, hypoxic burden, body weight, and blood pressure in different patient populations based on baseline characteristics such as age, sex, BMI, AHI, and neck circumference.
biomarkers_monitored.plain: This 2026 SURMOUNT-OSA analysis measured changes in sleep apnea severity (AHI, breathing pauses per hour), low-oxygen burden, body weight and blood pressure on tirzepatide, by age, sex, BMI, AHI and neck size.

biomarkers_monitored.value: Randomized controlled trial, humans, 2026: In the SURPASS-3 MRI substudy, tirzepatide significantly reduced liver fat content (LFC) versus insulin degludec in insulin-naïve patients with type 2 diabetes with metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease.
biomarkers_monitored.source_excerpt: In the SURPASS-3 MRI substudy, tirzepatide significantly reduced liver fat content (LFC) versus insulin degludec in insulin-naïve patients with type 2 diabetes with metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease.
biomarkers_monitored.plain: In the SURPASS-3 MRI substudy, tirzepatide lowered liver fat measured by MRI more than insulin degludec in people with type 2 diabetes and fatty liver disease who had not used insulin before.

biomarkers_monitored.value: Randomized controlled trial, humans, 2026: In the SURMOUNT clinical trial program, once-weekly tirzepatide resulted in substantial body weight reductions in people with obesity, without and with type 2 diabetes.
biomarkers_monitored.source_excerpt: In the SURMOUNT clinical trial program, once-weekly tirzepatide resulted in substantial body weight reductions in people with obesity, without and with type 2 diabetes.
biomarkers_monitored.plain: Background from a 2026 SURMOUNT analysis: once-weekly tirzepatide produced large weight loss in people with obesity, with and without type 2 diabetes; the analysis tracked weight, blood pressure and non-HDL cholesterol.

biomarkers_monitored.value: Randomized controlled trial, humans, n=392, 2026: Tirzepatide is a once-weekly glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide and glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonist approved for treatment of type 2 diabetes and obesity.
biomarkers_monitored.source_excerpt: Tirzepatide is a once-weekly glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide and glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonist approved for treatment of type 2 diabetes and obesity.
biomarkers_monitored.plain: Background: tirzepatide is a once-weekly drug acting on the GIP and GLP-1 receptors, approved for type 2 diabetes and obesity; this 2026 SURMOUNT-1 analysis of 392 people measured heart risk blood markers.

biomarkers_monitored.value: Randomized controlled trial, humans, n=6,586, 2026: The dual glucagon-like peptide 1 (GLP-1) and glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide (GIP) agonist tirzepatide was noninferior to a GLP-1 agonist, dulaglutide, for effects on the composite outcome of cardiovascular death, myocardial infarction (MI), or stroke.
biomarkers_monitored.source_excerpt: The dual glucagon-like peptide 1 (GLP-1) and glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide (GIP) agonist tirzepatide was noninferior to a GLP-1 agonist, dulaglutide, for effects on the composite outcome of cardiovascular death, myocardial infarction (MI), or stroke.
biomarkers_monitored.plain: Background from a 2026 SURPASS-CVOT analysis: tirzepatide was found no worse than dulaglutide on a combined outcome of heart-related death, heart attack or stroke.

biomarkers_monitored.value: Randomized controlled trial, humans, n=190, 2026: To evaluate the efficacy and safety of tirzepatide versus semaglutide in individuals eligible for pharmacotherapy for obesity disease under Japan's national insurance criteria, where obesity is defined as body mass index (BMI) ≥25 kg/m 2 with excess adiposity.
biomarkers_monitored.source_excerpt: To evaluate the efficacy and safety of tirzepatide versus semaglutide in individuals eligible for pharmacotherapy for obesity disease under Japan's national insurance criteria, where obesity is defined as body mass index (BMI) ≥25 kg/m 2 with excess adiposity.
biomarkers_monitored.plain: This 2026 analysis compared how well tirzepatide and semaglutide worked, and their side effects, in people eligible for obesity treatment under Japan's insurance rules (BMI of 25 or more with excess body fat).

reported_timelines.value: Randomized controlled trial, humans, 2026: After 16 weeks of treatment, compared with the MET group, the COM group resulted in greater reductions in weight (-1.7 ± 2.5 kg vs. -10.4 ± 3.5 kg; p 2 ; p 2 ; p Conclusions In overweight/obese women with PCOS, low-dose tirzepatide combined with MET was associated with greater reductions in body weight and visceral fat, along with improvements in metabolic and reproductive outcomes compared with MET monotherapy.
reported_timelines.source_excerpt: After 16 weeks of treatment, compared with the MET group, the COM group resulted in greater reductions in weight (-1.7 ± 2.5 kg vs. -10.4 ± 3.5 kg; p 2 ; p 2 ; p Conclusions In overweight/obese women with PCOS, low-dose tirzepatide combined with MET was associated with greater reductions in body weight and visceral fat, along with improvements in metabolic and reproductive outcomes compared with MET monotherapy.
reported_timelines.plain: In a 2026 open-label trial of women with PCOS and overweight or obesity, after 16 weeks average weight change was -10.4 kg on low-dose tirzepatide plus metformin versus -1.7 kg on metformin alone.

reported_timelines.value: Randomized controlled trial, humans, n=538, 2026: After 72 weeks of tirzepatide (10/15 mg), 16.7% of participants achieved a WHtR ≤ 0.49, and 54.7% improved their baseline WHtR category compared to 9.6% with placebo.
reported_timelines.source_excerpt: After 72 weeks of tirzepatide (10/15 mg), 16.7% of participants achieved a WHtR ≤ 0.49, and 54.7% improved their baseline WHtR category compared to 9.6% with placebo.
reported_timelines.plain: In a 2026 SURMOUNT-1 analysis of 538 people, after 72 weeks of tirzepatide 10 or 15 mg, 16.7% reached a waist-to-height ratio of 0.49 or less and 54.7% moved to a better category, against 9.6% on placebo.

storage.value: Approved label (EU, Mounjaro), section 6.4: store at 2 to 8 °C; do not freeze; protect from light.
storage.source_excerpt: Store in a refrigerator (2 ºC – 8 ºC). Do not freeze. Pre-filled pen, single-dose; vial, single-dose Store in original package in order to protect from light.
storage.plain: Mounjaro pens and vials are kept in a refrigerator at 2 to 8 °C, are not frozen, and stay in the original package to protect them from light.

storage.value: Approved label (EU, Mounjaro), section 6.3: single-dose pen or vial up to 21 cumulative days below 30 °C, then discard.
storage.source_excerpt: Mounjaro can be stored unrefrigerated for up to 21 cumulative days at a temperature below 30 ºC and then the pre-filled pen or vial must be discarded.
storage.plain: A single-dose pen or vial can spend up to 21 days in total out of the fridge below 30 °C. After that it is thrown away.

storage.value: Approved label (EU, Mounjaro), section 6.3: KwikPen discarded 30 days after first use.
storage.source_excerpt: The pre-filled KwikPen must be discarded 30 days after first use.
storage.plain: The multi-dose KwikPen is thrown away 30 days after its first use, whether it was kept in the fridge or below 30 °C.

study_durations.value: Randomized controlled trial, humans, 2026: durations stated: 52 week. This post hoc analysis evaluated changes in MRI-assessed LFC and cardiometabolic parameters by presence (genotypes GG and CG) or absence (genotype CC) of the PNPLA3 I148M allele after 52-week treatment.
study_durations.source_excerpt: This post hoc analysis evaluated changes in MRI-assessed LFC and cardiometabolic parameters by presence (genotypes GG and CG) or absence (genotype CC) of the PNPLA3 I148M allele after 52-week treatment.
study_durations.plain: This 2026 SURPASS-3 MRI analysis looked at liver fat changes after 52-week treatment, comparing people with and without a gene variant (PNPLA3 I148M) linked to fatty liver.

study_durations.value: Randomized controlled trial, humans, n=392, 2026: durations stated: 24 weeks; 72 weeks. The aforementioned biomarkers were assayed from plasma samples, collected at baseline, 24 weeks, and 72 weeks, from 100 randomly selected participants from each group of the SURMOUNT-1 trial who completed treatment with once-weekly placebo or tirzepatide 5, 10, or 15 mg (n = 392 after low sample volumes excluded).
study_durations.source_excerpt: The aforementioned biomarkers were assayed from plasma samples, collected at baseline, 24 weeks, and 72 weeks, from 100 randomly selected participants from each group of the SURMOUNT-1 trial who completed treatment with once-weekly placebo or tirzepatide 5, 10, or 15 mg (n = 392 after low sample volumes excluded).
study_durations.plain: In this 2026 SURMOUNT-1 analysis, blood samples were taken at the start, at 24 weeks and at 72 weeks from 392 people on weekly placebo or tirzepatide 5, 10 or 15 mg.

study_durations.value: Randomized controlled trial, humans, n=441, 2026: durations stated: 24 weeks. Starting at week 84 (24 weeks after random allocation), participants could receive rescue tirzepatide if their weight regain exceeded 50%.
study_durations.source_excerpt: Starting at week 84 (24 weeks after random allocation), participants could receive rescue tirzepatide if their weight regain exceeded 50%.
study_durations.plain: In the 2026 SURMOUNT-MAINTAIN trial, from week 84 (24 weeks after random assignment) participants could get rescue tirzepatide if they had regained more than 50% of lost weight.

study_durations.value: Randomized controlled trial, humans, n=102, 2026: durations stated: 16 weeks. In participants receiving apitegromab, trough concentrations of apitegromab and total latent myostatin, a pharmacodynamic marker, both increased over time and reached a plateau after approximately 16 weeks.
study_durations.source_excerpt: In participants receiving apitegromab, trough concentrations of apitegromab and total latent myostatin, a pharmacodynamic marker, both increased over time and reached a plateau after approximately 16 weeks.
study_durations.plain: In a 2026 phase 2 trial of 102 people on tirzepatide, blood levels of the added drug apitegromab and its marker myostatin rose and leveled off after about 16 weeks.

faq.question: Has Tirzepatide been tested in humans?
faq.answer: Yes. Europe PMC indexes 109 clinical trials and 131 randomized controlled trials naming Tirzepatide or a listed alias in the title or abstract. The evidence table above lists the ones in this record's ledger with their design and sample size; check the study name, since an alias can refer to a different formulation of the same molecule.

faq.question: What kind of evidence exists for Tirzepatide?
faq.answer: The strongest tier is approved label: an approved medicine with a regulator-reviewed label. Every claim on this page carries its own tier, because a compound with one human trial and forty animal studies is described by both facts, not the better one.

faq.question: Is Tirzepatide an approved medicine?
faq.answer: ChEMBL records CHEMBL4297839 at maximum clinical phase 4, first approved 2022. Approval status differs by jurisdiction and is pending human review on this record.

faq.question: Which species has Tirzepatide been studied in?
faq.answer: Studies in this record's ledger report work in: Humans. Findings in one species do not transfer to another, and weight-normalized doses in particular do not scale linearly between them.
